user.title: Connect to rainpointd
user.description: Enter the address of the local RainPoint gateway.

hassio_confirm.title: Set up RainPoint Local Gateway
hassio_confirm.description: Connect Home Assistant to the RainPoint Local Gateway add-on. Authorization will be configured automatically.

adopt_node.title: Adopt RainPoint radio node
adopt_node.description: Home Assistant discovered {node_id}. Choose its name and area; the next screen will blink the selected node for physical confirmation.

node_confirmation_progress.title: Identify the radio node
node_confirmation_progress.description: Press the BOOT button once on the blinking radio node. No ID or setup token is required.

node_adoption_progress.title: Adopting radio node
node_adoption_progress.description: Waiting for the node to authenticate with the custom local gateway.

error.invalid_response: The gateway returned an incompatible response

abort.already_configured: This local gateway is already configured
abort.gateway_required: Set up the RainPoint Local Gateway before adopting radio nodes

abort.confirmation_timeout: The BOOT button was not pressed before identification expired
abort.adoption_timeout: The radio node did not connect to the custom local gateway before adoption expired

progress.commission_wait: Waiting for the selected radio and fresh valve telemetry. Pairing is complete, but controls are not verified yet.
progress.commission_open: Sending a bounded test run and waiting for the valve to confirm it opened.
progress.commission_watering: The valve confirmed watering. Checking its automatic stop, then performing a second bounded run with an early stop.
progress.commission_close: Waiting for the valve's close confirmation and an independent idle report.
progress.wait_for_device: Listening on {node_name} for {device_name} for up to {duration_seconds} seconds. Start pairing on the device and keep it near the radio node.
progress.exchange_with_device: A {device_name} request was detected. {node_name} is completing the model-specific pairing exchange; keep the device nearby until its LED sequence finishes.
progress.confirm_device: Pairing messages were sent. Waiting for {device_name} to confirm its assigned local identity.
progress.finalize_pairing: The device accepted pairing. Waiting for {node_name} to finish and become ready for commands.

commission_review.title: Valve paired — verify controls
commission_review.description: Pairing alone does not confirm watering controls. Verification uses the selected radio and requires your approval before water can flow.

commission_start.title: Approve valve verification
commission_start.description: This test can release water. It requests two 60-second runs: the first stops automatically; the second is stopped early after at least 20 seconds. Allow up to two minutes of watering, or disconnect the valve from water first. Keep this screen open. Closing it stops further test steps, but an already-started run may continue to its automatic stop. No failed open is retried automatically.

data.test_watering_confirmed: I approve these bounded watering tests

commission_result.title: {result}
commission_result.description: {reason}. Only positive valve responses and independent stop reports enable normal controls. If verification failed or was interrupted, inspect the valve before pairing and testing again; an unconfirmed run may still have occurred.

authenticate_gateway.title: Authenticate standalone gateway
authenticate_gateway.description: Enter the one-time setup code printed by a standalone gateway. An existing management token remains available for recovery. Add-on credentials are configured automatically.

add_radio_node.title: Add custom local radio node
add_radio_node.description: Manual fallback for a custom ESP32 radio node, not for pairing a sensor or valve. Normally, configure the radio's Wi-Fi, then adopt it from Discovered in Devices & services and confirm with its BOOT button. Use this form only when you already have a provisioned radio's ID and 64-character setup token. The credential is stored privately by the custom local gateway.

remove_radio_node.title: Remove custom local radio node
remove_radio_node.description: This immediately revokes the selected node's credential. RainPoint sensors and valves are retained.

add_sensor.title: Choose a sensor model
add_sensor.description: Select one of the sensor families supported by this custom local gateway.

add_valve.title: Choose a valve model
add_valve.description: Select one of the valve families supported by this custom local gateway.

pair_device.title: Pair {device_name}
pair_device.description: Temporarily unplug the original RainPoint gateway, then select the custom local radio node nearest the device. RainPoint Local discovers the device's radio identity automatically.

forget_sensor.title: Forget a local sensor
forget_sensor.description: Select the sensor to remove from RainPoint Local. Its entities will be hidden while its Home Assistant identity and history are retained for reassociation.

confirm_forget_sensor.title: Confirm local sensor removal
confirm_forget_sensor.description: Forget {name} ({endpoint})? This removes its local enrollment and suppresses rediscovery. It sends no RF unpair or factory-reset command, so the physical sensor may still need to be reset before pairing again.

data.confirm: I understand that this does not reset the physical sensor

pairing_progress.title: Waiting for RainPoint device
pairing_progress.description: Keep the original RainPoint gateway unplugged. Pairing may continue briefly after the LED changes while the radio node verifies the exchange. A previously known device keeps its Home Assistant identity.

device_details.title: {device_name} discovered
device_details.description: The custom local gateway validated device endpoint {endpoint}. Choose its Home Assistant name and area.

pairing_review.title: Review pairing
pairing_review.description: Pair {device_name} using {node_name}. The radio will listen for {duration_seconds} seconds after you select Start pairing. Back returns to the radio and timeout settings without starting pairing. Close this dialog with X to exit.
